Decision intelligence

## One agent loop. Every decision.

  1. Sense

### Watch the signals

Agents ingest live operational, market and sensor data and keep the source of every fact.

  2. Weigh

### Model the options

Models on the Dragon core compare scenarios, costs and risks, and show their reasoning.

  3. Decide

### Keep people in charge

A ranked recommendation with evidence goes to the person who owns the call. Every step is logged.

Electron → Product

## We own every layer between an electron and a decision.

Decisions are only as fast, cheap and trustworthy as the stack under them. So we build all of it.

  1. L0→

### Silicon

GPUs, wafer-scale chips and Apple Silicon. Where the electrons move.

  2. L1→

### Kernels

CUDA, Metal and llama.cpp tuned for speed per watt.

  3. L2→

### Models

Frontier and open models, or the ones the customer approves.

  4. L3→

### Dragon core

Routes each request across more than 1,000 models.

  5. L4→

### Agents

Plan, use tools, remember and explain every step.

  6. L5

### Product

A decision a person can act on: Optamax, Dragon Code, TokenMax.

# Cookie Policy

## Our cookie policy and how we use them

# Vellora Cookie Policy

Effective date: August 20, 2025

Who we are: Vellora, Inc. ("Vellora," "we," "us," or "our"). This policy applies to vellora.ai and the Vellora app.

## Our simple stance

We use only essential cookies needed for the site and app to work. We do not use analytics, advertising, or social tracking cookies. We do not sell or share cookie data.

## What essential cookies do

Essential cookies enable core functions such as:

  * Authentication & sessions – keeping you signed in and securing your account.
  * Security & fraud prevention – e.g., CSRF protection and abuse detection.
  * Performance & availability – load balancing and uptime features.

Without these cookies, Vellora will not function properly. Because they are strictly necessary, consent is not requested for them.

## What we store (at a high level)

We may store a session identifier, a CSRF token, and limited configuration needed to deliver features you turn on. We do not store or read third‑party tracking identifiers.

## How long they last

Essential cookies are session‑based or short‑lived. Most expire when you sign out or close your browser. Some may last a little longer (e.g., up to 30 days) to remember essential settings.

## Your choices

You can block cookies in your browser settings, but Vellora may not work correctly without essential cookies. If we ever add non‑essential cookies (e.g., analytics), we will update this page and request your consent where required.

## Changes

We may update this policy. We will post changes here and update the Effective date.

## Contact

Questions? Email hello@vellora.ai.
